integrity: The graph upper bound and the complete triple-overlap check are both essential. Two standalone, independently implemented exact finite checkers with all twelve witnesses are supplied; no independence beyond this self-review is claimed.
limitations: Only reversal-closed binary words of length eight are classified; there is no claim of generalized optimality for all lengths, stronger cross-bifix-free codes, or error correction. Bibliographic overlap with inaccessible or unindexed older code enumerations is possible.
title: Exact binary length-eight self-reflective comma-free codes
